name: Briarmane Mane Braid
description: A small braided cord of Briarmane Courser mane hair — given by the mount to its bonded rider through shedding, then worked by the rider into a keepsake.
narrative_effects: A relational token between a bonded rider and a Briarmane Courser. Non-tradeable in the ordinary sense — separated from its rider, the braid carries no meaningful effect.
Recognized by other Briarmanes as a signal of the bearer's established relationship with a courser, affecting initial encounter behavior.
Common among Feywood riders and Silverbow rangers; rare realm-side except among Feywood-bonded individuals who have traveled outward.

mechanical_effect.trigger: carried by the bonded rider while interacting with Briarmane Coursers or those who recognize the braid's relational meaning
mechanical_effect.applies_to: initial encounter, calming, recognition, or trust-framing checks involving Briarmane Coursers or Feywood riders who understand the token
mechanical_effect.does_not_apply: bearers separated from the actual bonded relationship; ordinary animal handling unrelated to Briarmanes; groups that do not recognize the braid
